tool.name: FileConverter
tool.description: Converts between different MS file formats
tool.command:
@QUOTE_FOO@ @EXT_FOO@ #import re
## Preprocessing mkdir in && cp '$in' 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' && mkdir out && ## advanced options #if $OpenSwathWorkflow.tr: mkdir OpenSwathWorkflow.tr && cp '$OpenSwathWorkflow.tr' 'OpenSwathWorkflow.tr/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $OpenSwathWorkflow.tr.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($OpenSwathWorkflow.tr.ext)' && #end if
## Main program call
#if "out_featureparquet_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir -p out_featureparquet_bundle && #end if #if "out_consensusparquet_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir -p out_consensusparquet_bundle && #end if set -o pipefail && @EXECUTABLE@ -write_ctd ./ && python3 '$__tool_directory__/fill_ctd.py' '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$args_json' '$hardcoded_json' && @EXECUTABLE@ -ini @EXECUTABLE@.ctd -in 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' #if "out_featureparquet_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_type featureparquet #elif "out_consensusparquet_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_type consensusparquet #end if -out #if "out_featureparquet_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') 'out_featureparquet_bundle/out.featureparquet' #elif "out_consensusparquet_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') 'out_consensusparquet_bundle/out.consensusparquet' #else 'out/output.${out_type}' #end if ## advanced options #if $OpenSwathWorkflow.tr: -OpenSwathWorkflow:tr 'OpenSwathWorkflow.tr/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $OpenSwathWorkflow.tr.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($OpenSwathWorkflow.tr.ext)' #end if
## Postprocessing #if "out_featureparquet_FLAG" not in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') and "out_consensusparquet_FLAG" not in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out/output.${out_type}' '$out' #end if #if "ctd_out_FLAG" in $OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS && mv '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$ctd_out' #end if

param.label: Input file to convert
Output file type -- default: determined from file extension or content
param.help: Note: that not all conversion paths work or make sense

validator.message: A value needs to be selected

section.name: RawToMzML
section.title: Options for converting Thermo raw files

param.name: no_peak_picking
param.label: Disables vendor peak picking for raw files

param.name: no_zlib_compression
param.label: Disables zlib compression for raw file conversion
param.help: Enables compatibility with some tools that do not support compressed input files, e.g. X!Tandem (external reader only)

param.name: include_noise
param.label: Include noise data in mzML output

param.name: reader
param.label: Reader for Thermo .raw files
param.help: 'external' uses ThermoRawFileParser (external .NET process, mzML output only; the default on windows); 'inprocess' uses the built-in ThermoRawFile (in-process, supports any output format; requires WITH_THERMO_RAW build and a .NET 8 runtime; the default on linux and mac)

section.name: OpenSwathWorkflow
section.title: Options for loading OpenSWATH transition libraries used for chromatogram metadata

param.name: tr
param.label: Transition library (PQP, TSV, or TraML) providing precursor/transition metadata
param.help: Required when converting sqMass to CHROMPARQUET (.xic); XICs without associated metadata are not meaningful select osw,pqp,tabular,traml data sets(s)

param.name: legacy_traml_id
param.label: When loading PQP libraries: use legacy TraML IDs (TRAML_ID) instead of numeric IDs
unique ID post-processing for output data
param.help: 'none' keeps current IDs even if invalid.. 'ensure' keeps current IDs but reassigns invalid ones.. 'reassign' assigns new unique IDs

param.label: Export the TIC instead of the entire experiment in mzML/mzData/mzXML -> DTA2D conversions
Use a more compact format when writing MGF (no zero-intensity peaks, limited number of decimal places)
[mzXML output only] Make sure that MaxQuant can read the mzXML and set the msManufacturer to 'Thermo Scientific'
[mzML output only] Make sure that TPP parsers can read the mzML and the precursor ion m/z in the file (otherwise it will be set to zero by the TPP)
[mzML output only] Assumes that the provided spectra represent data in SRM mode or targeted MS1 mode and converts them to chromatogram data
Append an index when writing mzML or mzXML files
param.help: Some external tools might rely on it

param.label: Use numpress compression to achieve optimally small file size using linear compression for m/z domain and slof for intensity and float data arrays (attention: may cause small loss of precision; only for mzML data)
[mzML output only] Compress binary data arrays with Zstandard (zstd) instead of zlib (lossless; can be combined with 'lossy_compression')
param.help: Attention: not all external tools can read zstd-compressed mzML files yet

param.label: Desired (absolute) m/z accuracy for lossy compression
param.help: (e.g. use 0.0001 for a mass accuracy of 0.2 ppm at 500 m/z, default uses -1.0 for maximal accuracy)

param.label: Whether to process the file on the fly without loading the whole file into memory first (only for conversions of mzXML/mzML to mzML)
param.help: Note: this flag will prevent conversion from spectra to chromatograms

param.label: Overrides tool-specific checks
Enables the test mode (needed for internal use only)

param.name: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS
param.label: Optional outputs

collection.name: out_featureparquet
collection.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out (featureparquet bundle)
collection.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_featureparquet_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

collection.name: out_consensusparquet
collection.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out (consensusparquet bundle)
collection.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_consensusparquet_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is None or ("out_featureparquet_FLAG" not in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS and "out_consensusparquet_FLAG" not in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS)

data.name: ctd_out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: ctd
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "ctd_out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

tool.help:
Converts between different MS file formats.
For more information, visit http://www.openms.de/doxygen/release/3.6.0/html/TOPP_FileConverter.html
